requirement_vague: User profile update should reject invalid email format. Test with 'invalid@' string.
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test58@example.com' and password 'validpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to update profile via PATCH /api/v1/users/me with email 'invalid@' (invalid format). Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The profile update request model declares email as Optional[EmailStr], so FastAPI/Pydantic validates the email format before entering the handler. An invalid value like 'invalid@' will be rejected as a validation error, which FastAPI returns with status 422 for request body validation failures.
